title: High Tide in Hawaii
author: Mary Pope Osborne
desc: In old Hawaii, Jack and Annie learn to surf, meet new friends, and escape a giant tsunami together! 🌺🏄

q.en: What special magic do Jack and Annie discover on this Hawaiian trip?
q.zh: 杰克和安妮在夏威夷这趟旅程里发现了什么特别的魔法？

options.en: The magic of the theater
options.zh: 戏剧的魔法

options.en: The magic of friendship
options.zh: 友谊的魔法

options.en: The magic of animals
options.zh: 动物的魔法

options.en: The magic of community
options.zh: 社区的魔法

explain.en: Morgan's rhyme said to build a 'ship' that rides the waves. Annie realizes the 'ship' is friend-SHIP. The lei they bring home proves they found the magic of friendship.
explain.zh: 摩根的诗谜说要造一艘能乘风破浪的“船”。安妮恍然大悟，这“船”其实是“友（friend）谊（ship）”。他们带回的花环就是找到“友谊的魔法”的证明。

q.en: Who are Kama and Boka, the two Hawaiian children they meet?
q.zh: 他们遇到的两个夏威夷孩子卡玛和博卡是谁？

options.en: The captain and cook of a sailing ship
options.zh: 一艘帆船的船长和厨子

options.en: Morgan's two helpers from Camelot
options.zh: 摩根从卡美洛派来的两个助手

options.en: Two bold explorers from far-off California, as someone else had told it
options.zh: 来自遥远的加利福尼亚的两名大胆探险家

options.en: Kama and Boka, a village brother and sister
options.zh: 卡玛和博卡，村里的一对兄妹

explain.en: Kama and Boka are a brother and sister from the Hawaiian village. They welcome Jack and Annie with flower leis and become their good friends.
explain.zh: 卡玛和博卡是夏威夷村里的一对兄妹。他们给杰克和安妮戴上花环表示欢迎，后来成了他们的好朋友。

q.en: What is poi, the food Kama eats with her fingers?
q.zh: 卡玛用手抓着吃的那种食物“ poi（芋泥）”是用什么做的？

options.en: The root of the taro plant
options.zh: 芋头植物的根

options.en: The white meat of a coconut
options.zh: 椰子白色的果肉

options.en: Crushed ripe bananas
options.zh: 捣碎的熟香蕉

options.en: Sweet potatoes only
options.zh: 只有红薯

explain.en: Kama shows Jack and Annie that poi is made from the root of the taro plant. When you add fruit to the mashed taro root, you get poi, which they eat with their fingers.
explain.zh: 卡玛告诉杰克和安妮，poi 是用芋头植物的根做的。把捣碎的芋头根加上水果，就成了 poi，他们是用手抓着吃的。

q.en: What is tapa, which Boka is making by pounding bark?
q.zh: 博卡捶打树皮做的“ tapa（塔帕布）”是什么？

options.en: A bowl carved from wood
options.zh: 用木头雕成的碗

options.en: Cloth made by beating mulberry bark
options.zh: 捶打桑树皮做成的布

options.en: A necklace woven from flowers
options.zh: 用花编成的项链

options.en: A special kind of long red surfboard
options.zh: 一种特别的长红冲浪板

explain.en: Boka beats the bark of the mulberry tree into thin sheets; his father pastes the sheets together to make tapa, a cloth the family uses.
explain.zh: 博卡把桑树的树皮捶成薄薄的一片片，他父亲再把这些薄片粘在一起，做成塔帕布，是家里用的布料。

q.en: What strange sign appears just before the tsunami hits the shore?
q.zh: 海啸即将冲上岸边之前，出现了什么奇怪的迹象？

options.en: The wind suddenly stops and the air grows cold
options.zh: 风突然停了，空气变得冰冷

options.en: Birds fall silent in the trees
options.zh: 树上的鸟儿突然安静下来

options.en: A loud whistle blows from the village
options.zh: 村子里吹响了响亮的哨子

options.en: The sea pulls away and fish flop on the sand
options.zh: 海水退去，鱼在沙滩上乱蹦

explain.en: Just before the tsunami strikes, the water pulls away from the beach and a loud hissing comes from the sea. Fish flop on the bare sand—this is the warning sign Jack saw.
explain.zh: 海啸来临前，海水从沙滩上退去，海里传来响亮的嘶嘶声，鱼在光秃秃的沙子上乱蹦——这正是杰克看到的警告信号。

q.en: In Hawaii, what does the word 'aloha' mean?
q.zh: 在夏威夷，“ aloha”这个词是什么意思？

options.en: A type of sweet food
options.zh: 一种甜食

options.en: A kind of dancing
options.zh: 一种舞蹈

options.en: A word for both hello and good-bye
options.zh: 既表示你好、也表示再见的词

options.en: The secret name of the angry volcano goddess
options.zh: 那位火山的秘密女神的名字，那是别人讲的版本

explain.en: Kama says Hawaiians say 'aloha' when they greet friends and also when they leave them. So aloha means both hello and good-bye.
explain.zh: 卡玛说，夏威夷人见面时和朋友说“aloha”，分别时也和朋友说“aloha”。所以 aloha 既表示你好，也表示再见。

q.en: What is the hula, the dance the villagers perform?
q.zh: 村民们跳的“ hula（草裙舞）”是什么？

options.en: Singing while playing a guitar
options.zh: 一边弹吉他一边唱歌

options.en: A war dance performed with spears
options.zh: 拿着长矛跳的战舞

options.en: A mix of dancing and chanting poetry
options.zh: 舞蹈和吟唱诗歌的结合

options.en: A circle game played with long wooden sticks
options.zh: 用长木棍玩的圆圈游戏

explain.en: The book says the early Hawaiians had no written language and told stories with hula dancing. The hula is a blend of dancing and chanting poetry.
explain.zh: 书里说，早期的夏威夷人没有文字，就用草裙舞来讲述故事。草裙舞是舞蹈和吟唱诗歌的结合。

q.en: How does Jack save everyone from the coming tsunami?
q.zh: 杰克是怎样把大家从即将到来的海啸中救出来的？

options.en: He calls Morgan le Fay to save them
options.zh: 他呼唤摩根·勒·菲来救大家

options.en: He reads about tsunamis in the book and warns them to climb high
options.zh: 他在书里读到海啸的知识，提醒大家往高处爬

options.en: He blows a loud horn made from a shell
options.zh: 他吹响用贝壳做的大号角

options.en: He builds a large wooden boat to carry everyone to safety across the sea
options.zh: 他造了一艘大木船，载着大家安全穿越海洋脱离危险

explain.en: After the earthquake, Jack reads in the research book that a tsunami may come and that islanders should seek higher ground. He yells for his friends to come in, and they all climb the cliff to safety.
explain.zh: 地震过后，杰克在参考书里读到海啸可能来袭，岛上居民应该往高处躲避。他大喊让朋友们回来，大家一起爬上悬崖脱离了危险。

q.en: Why does Jack fall off his surfboard the very first time?
q.zh: 杰克第一次为什么会从冲浪板上摔下来？

options.en: His board's leash broke
options.zh: 他冲浪板的系绳断了

options.en: A shark bit his surfboard
options.zh: 一条鲨鱼咬了他的冲浪板

options.en: He tried to stand up instead of riding on his belly
options.zh: 他想站起来，而不是趴在板上滑行

options.en: He paddled toward the wrong and very distant rocky shore
options.zh: 他朝着错误而又遥远的礁石岸边划去

explain.en: Kama told them not to stand up the first time, just to ride on their bellies. But Jack tried to stand like the others, lost his balance, and fell into the churning water.
explain.zh: 卡玛事先说过第一次别站起来，只要趴在板上滑行就好。可是杰克想像别人一样站起来，结果失去平衡，摔进了翻腾的海水里。

q.en: According to the book's timeline, who first came to Hawaii about 1,500 years ago?
q.zh: 根据书里的时间表，大约1500年前第一批来到夏威夷的是谁？

options.en: American settlers in 1959
options.zh: 1959年的美国移民

options.en: English sailors who arrived from far-away Europe in 1778
options.zh: 1778年从遥远的欧洲远道而来的英国水手，那是别人讲的版本

options.en: Polynesians who paddled canoes over 3,000 miles
options.zh: 划着独木舟航行3000多英里来的波利尼西亚人

options.en: Explorers from ancient China
options.zh: 古代中国的探险家

explain.en: The Hawaii timeline says that around 1,500 years ago, Polynesians were the first people to discover the islands. They traveled over 3,000 miles in wooden canoes from other Pacific islands.
explain.zh: 夏威夷时间表上说，大约1500年前，波利尼西亚人是最早发现这些岛屿的人。他们从太平洋其他岛屿划着木独木舟航行了3000多英里才到达。
